summary: Independent scoped offline approval of explicit AgentHost/CLI summary-cache wiring, preflight, shared private context, restart reuse and dual-store lifecycle; no supported new security or logic defect found.
scope: Host/CLI optional cache configuration and wiring only. Real private fixture files, local subprocesses, joined local worker/inspector threads and FakeGameClient; no native/provider/world acceptance.

review_method.accepted_dependencies: Memory and raw/cache backends unchanged; inspected ownership and integration behavior, did not independently re-review all unchanged cache parsers. Prior independent 210-case cache approval read only for boundaries; none of its cases counted here.
review_method.runtime: Existing pinned nix develop --offline --no-write-lock-file -c uv run --offline --no-sync. No installs, pin edits, baseline stash, source fixes, staging, commit or push.
review_method.offline_guards: Selected test runner replaces host chat autodetection with StaticChatGenerator and denies socket.create_connection, CLI.main and AgentHost.run. Fresh harness additionally denies native BotClient. Fixture fake inspector threads do not serve sockets. Valid CLI build_host allocates cached memories but never calls main/run.
review_method.isolation: Owned COVERAGE_FILE, basetemp, mypy/Pylint caches, no pytest cacheprovider, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; only new report plus own scratch written.
review_method.tdd: Historical implementation RED claims were read, not independently rerun. Behavioral raw-only restart seven-regeneration evidence is distinct from API missing-keyword RED and CLI/preflight RED; fresh review does not infer tests-first history from current passing counts.

coverage.scope: Three scoped source modules, not project-wide or per-file >=85; CLI.main/AgentHost.run intentionally excluded from execution. Autodetection patched to prevent actual socket attempts.

verification.full_combined_gate: Not run; parent-owned. Scoped static Black/Ruff/strict mypy/Bandit pass; whole-source Vulture, Xenon B/B/A and duplicate-code pass on an unchanged 56-module source snapshot. No gates weakened.

Exact 128-byte ASCII IDs accepted; str subclass overrides not invoked. Existing 72 host-cache cases include pair/root and argparse exit-2 guards.

positive_controls_and_reached_probes.cli: Fresh parse-derived Namespace builds actual host and two private cache files with exact world/policy labels and no client/native session; no-cache defaults have neither durable store.
positive_controls_and_reached_probes.restart_notes_view_zoom: Fresh two-persona real-file host builds 14 nodes, seven per four-note persona. A new local process with exploding summarizer verifies exact raw notes, views, zoom, inspector source-log identity and zero old-summary calls. Fifth note on reconstruction requires exactly one leaf summarization.
positive_controls_and_reached_probes.shared_private_context: Fresh cached facade is the identical brain memory and inspector MemoryLog. Fake-client chat callback drives both scripted decision context and static LLM prompt path. Owned notes present, foreign-persona marker absent; prompt private-memory segment remains <=4000 characters. No actual LLM inference.
positive_controls_and_reached_probes.schedule_and_dual_locks: Fresh schedule-on/off/on/off passes connect/disconnect FakeGameClients while retaining same facade. Separate local process denied both lifetime locks for both personas after disconnect; normal stop permits reopen and stopped step cannot reconnect.
positive_controls_and_reached_probes.constructor_cleanup: Fresh supported second-persona decision_factory failure exercises real raw/cache stores. Four stores each close exactly once even when each raises after release; separate process reopens all. OSError/Unnotable OSError/KeyboardInterrupt origins retain object, errno where applicable and decision traceback frame; failing add_note and secondary private strings cannot replace/leak into diagnostics. Selected current tests separately cover cache allocation, raw/cache restore, bind and ScheduledAgent failure with all previously completed personas.
positive_controls_and_reached_probes.stop_cleanup: Fresh simultaneous session append OSError and raw release-before-SystemExit produces original errors in BaseExceptionGroup only after both fake clients disconnect and all raw/cache files reopen in separate process. Selected current tests exercise worker and inspector joins before either store closes and session failure cleanup.
positive_controls_and_reached_probes.actual_pre_release_interruption: Two fresh probes reach inherited backend os.close before releasing raw or cache file fd during host.stop. Exact KeyboardInterrupt propagated with incomplete-release note; backend fd slot already -1 but os.fstat(saved fd) and writer-lock denial prove residual ownership BEFORE fixture recovery. Every other raw/cache store releases. Only exact saved fixture descriptor manually recovered afterward, no production retry/kill/recovery claim.
positive_controls_and_reached_probes.identity_source_and_world: Executed selected integration tests refuse wrong world/persona/policy, copied-policy and altered raw-prefix bindings without fallback. Explicit two-world positive controls use different caller-selected raw roots AND cache labels; no automatic raw-root world partition inferred.

suggestions.subject: CLI builder Namespace contract
suggestions.detail: Existing old/new tests use parse_args-produced namespaces; build_host directly requires newly added attributes. Arbitrary hand-built old Namespaces missing those fields are not demonstrated public compatibility. Clarify parse-derived Namespace contract if exposing builder more broadly.

limitations: Memory root remains explicitly caller-selected world-specific Path; cache world is an identity label, not raw ownership proof, automatic routing, deployment capability or world-start authority. Wrong-type memory_root outside annotated API is not elevated to a security claim.
Summary backend remains StubSummarizer at 120 characters. Opaque policy label is not model/provider proof; no Qwen/provider parity or billing acceptance.

Inherited pre-release close interruption can leave physical fd/flock retained despite cleared slots. Attempts and generic diagnostics are not universal release guarantees; no targeted production fix or recovery added.
Unchanged accepted backend repeated source-prefix hashing remains quadratic with finite admission caps; no scalability/performance acceptance.

No SQL, engine/socket/provider/network/native/private-human/gateway sessions, CLI.main/host.run, server/inference, world mutation or full OptChat/player-memory acceptance. User end goal and native/full-world milestones remain open.
No unrelated runtime publication journal ownership APIs conflated with Memory cleanup. Other journal review read-only; no new writers or source changes.
